info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Fiber and Composite Materials

description.describe_ch: 學習達成組織目標必須具備之四大功能中規劃、組織、領導及管制之學理、方法與應用。以幫助同學面對強大國際競爭及激烈之技術、營運方式及組織結構之變遷。
description.describe_eh: The objective of this course is to learn the principles and practical application of the four major functions of management. The Changes in technology, international affairs, business practices, and organizational structure etc. has caused managers to reexamine their roles. The scope of this course emphasis on the capability of a new era manager's required.
